name: device-envelope-downlink-text
notes: Sources: docs/design/device-connector-2026-10-31.md:150-156 (§4.2: audience is decided by the tool and never inferred from who started the turn; tool results never reach a device; permission and question requests reach the phone only) and :128-148 (§4.1). A downlink envelope is host-originated, so origin is phone or agent and never device. Downlink delivery is bounded by the session policy (tts, maxChars <= 1000, :154) rather than by message size. epoch is host-selected per (device, transport): it is persisted with the outbound sequence cursor and never re-derived from device-supplied state.
